typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select A.[Transaction ID] 	  ,A.[Transaction Type]  	  ,A.[Medicaid Card Number]  	  ,A.[Individual ID]  	  ,A.[Partner ID] 	  ,A.[Medically Frail Assessment Date] 	  ,A.[Medically Frail Confirmation Code] 	  ,A.[Medically Frail Reason Code]                     ,A. [Secondary Verification Source] 	  ,A.[Medically Frail Effective Date] 	  ,A.[Medically Frail End Date]                      ,\'\' as ReplaceCR From  ( select  	  CAST(A.[TransID] AS char(16)) as [Transaction ID] 	  ,CAST(A.[TransType] AS char(1)) as [Transaction Type] 	  ,CAST(A.[MedicaidCardNo] AS char(10)) as [Medicaid Card Number] 	  ,CAST(A.[IndividualID] AS char(10)) as [Individual ID] 	  ,CAST(A.[PartnerID] AS char(10)) as [Partner ID]  	  ,CAST(A.[MFIAssessmentDT] AS char(8)) as [Medically Frail Assessment Date] 	  ,CAST(A.[MFIConfirmationCode] AS char(1)) as [Medically Frail Confirmation Code] 	  ,CAST(A.[MFIReasonCode] AS char(1)) as [Medically Frail Reason Code]                      ,CAST(A.[SecondaryVerificationSource] AS char(1)) as [Secondary Verification Source] 	  ,CAST(A.[MFIEffectiveDT] AS char(8)) as [Medically Frail Effective Date] 	  ,CAST(A.[MFIEndDT] AS char(8)) as [Medically Frail End Date] 	  ,A.[DisplayOrder] 	  ,A.[RowNO]  from EXTRACT.Temp_KY_MF_OUTBOUNDFILE_FINAL A ) A Where A.[RowNO] =  1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Partner_ID as string,
		Transaction_Type as string,
		Medicaid_Card_Number as string,
		Individual_ID as string,
		Medically_Frail_Assessment_Date as string,
		Medically_Frail_Reason_Code as string,
		Secondary_Verification_Source as string,
		Medically_Frail_Confirmation_Code as string,
		Medically_Frail_Effective_Date as string,
		Transaction_ID as string,
		Medically_Frail_End_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Partner_ID = {Partner ID},
		Transaction_Type = {Transaction Type},
		Medicaid_Card_Number = {Medicaid Card Number},
		Individual_ID = {Individual ID},
		Medically_Frail_Assessment_Date = {Medically Frail Assessment Date},
		Medically_Frail_Reason_Code = {Medically Frail Reason Code},
		Secondary_Verification_Source = {Secondary Verification Source},
		Medically_Frail_Confirmation_Code = {Medically Frail Confirmation Code},
		Medically_Frail_Effective_Date = {Medically Frail Effective Date},
		Transaction_ID = {Transaction ID},
		Medically_Frail_End_Date = {Medically Frail End Date})) ~> FlatFileDestination1
